title: Fusajiro Yamauchi
extract: Fusajirō Yamauchi , originally born as Fusajirō Fukui , was a Japanese entrepreneur who founded Yamauchi Nintendo, later known as Nintendo. Yamauchi lived in Kyoto, Japan, and had a wife and two daughters—one of whom was Tei Yamauchi, who later married Sekiryō Kaneda, the successor and second president of Nintendo.
